description: Update the Supabase documentation to provide more comprehensive troubleshooting guides for egress and Edge Function 546 errors. Add visual aids and contextual explanations to help users diagnose and resolve these issues more effectively.
functional_requirements: Enhance the egress troubleshooting guide with additional context and visual elements to clarify common scenarios and solutions
Update the Edge Function 546 error troubleshooting guide with major revisions, including explanations of error patterns and resolution steps
Incorporate new visual assets (charts and screenshots) into the documentation to illustrate error metrics, log examples, and diagnostic results
